full_name: Bouchra Khalili | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow Oslo National Academy of the Arts (Norway)
bio: Bouchra Khalili is a Moroccan-French artist. She lives and works in Berlin and Oslo. Working with film, video, installation, photography, and prints, Khaliliʼs practice articulates language, subjectivity, orality, and geographical explorations to investigate strategies and discourses of resistance as elaborated, developed, and narrated by individuals—often members of political minorities.
